reason: The O(tau) moment budget—the quantitative heart of the obstruction—is asserted, not derived: no explicit constant C, no dual multipliers, and the load-bearing sub-claim that 'idempotence duality forbids the row from concentrating on z' (the actor with x=1, which would trivially give moment 1) is stated with no proof. Nor is it shown why a support fiber confined only by 0≤y≤1 cannot have x_Q~1/tau (since ||D||_1=tau allows |x_Q| up to ~1/tau within the ℓ¹ ball), which a small weight could exploit to reach O(1) moment.
